# PPG IBI Fixtures

This directory is reserved for future small fixtures used by smoke tests.

Fixture policy:

- Fixtures are only for smoke tests.
- Fixture results do not represent formal performance evaluation.
- Fixture results must not be used to claim that an algorithm meets acceptance targets.
- Real, private, or complete physiological datasets must not be committed to the repository.
- A de-identified small fixture may be added here only after Owner explicitly confirms
  that it is safe to commit and has a clear test purpose.
